basics.name: Jaisal Sharma
basics.label: Electronics, Communication, and Information Engineer
basics.summary: Electronics, Communication, and Information Engineer with expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning Systems, NLP, Generative AI (LLM, RAG), and AI security. Passionate about developing innovative solutions in trustworthy and fair AI systems.

work.name: Real Time Solutions
work.summary: Developed AI solutions for flood monitoring using computer vision techniques.
highlights: Adapted the RAFT (Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms) architecture using PyTorch to estimate river surface velocity, utilizing dense optical flow to quantify water motion from surveillance footage.
Applied this vision-based system for flood monitoring across Nepal's rivers, analyzing flow vectors to detect critical discharge rates and enhance non-intrusive early warning capabilities.

volunteer.summary: Volunteered at Locus, a national technological festival held annually at Pulchowk Campus.
highlights: Volunteered at Locus, where various software projects, robotics demonstrations, and drone environments are showcased.
Actively participated in organizing and supporting the drone competition during this event.

volunteer.summary: Educational outreach program in rural areas.
highlights: Visited rural areas and various schools across Baglung District, delivering engaging presentations on digital transformation to students.
Provided presentations on the importance and benefits of integrating technology in education.

volunteer.organization: Pulchowk Music Club and Research Center
volunteer.summary: Managed technical aspects of music events and workshops.
highlights: Organized and managed technical aspects of music fests, including sound engineering, equipment setup, and live performance coordination.
Conducted workshops and other music-related events, providing technical training and fostering collaboration among participants.

interests.name: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Systems

projects.name: Brain Tumor Classification: CNN vs Vision Transformer
projects.summary: Multi-axis evaluation of CNN and Vision Transformer robustness and interpretability for medical imaging.
highlights: Engineered a PyTorch pipeline to classify brain tumors, comparing ResNet-34 CNN against Vision Transformer (ViT) achieving 99.3% accuracy.
Investigated architectural trade-offs demonstrating ViT's superior feature localization and robustness to noise.

projects.name: Fairness-Aware Decision Tree (FAHT) Replication Study
projects.summary: Replicated the FAHT framework implementing Fair Information Gain for algorithmic fairness.
highlights: Implemented custom decision tree induction with Fair Information Gain (FIG) splitting criterion.
Achieved 48% reduction in Statistical Parity discrimination with negligible accuracy loss (<2%).

projects.name: GraLLM-Tutor: An Explainable AI Framework
projects.summary: LLM + Knowledge Graph integration for educational AI systems.
highlights: Engineered a novel XAI framework combining Llama 3 with ConceptNet knowledge graph.
Developed automated reasoning pipeline for concept extraction and explanation synthesis.

projects.name: SemDiff-QA: Semantic Differentiation for MCQA
projects.summary: Implemented DCQA paper (ECAI 2024) using discriminative ranking approach.
highlights: Re-architected T5-Base model into a discriminative ranker for list-wise classification.
Achieved 60.52% accuracy on CommonsenseQA with memory-efficient training pipeline.

projects.name: Adversarial Attacks on ResNeXt101 for Scene Classification
projects.summary: Investigation of FGSM adversarial attacks on deep learning models.
highlights: Implemented FGSM adversarial attacks demonstrating significant accuracy degradation.
Provided quantitative and visual analysis revealing critical security weaknesses.

projects.name: Explainable ML Pipeline for Stroke Prediction
projects.summary: Interpretable machine learning with LIME, SHAP, and InterpretML on EHR data.
highlights: Applied LIME, SHAP, and InterpretML for transparent model-agnostic explanations.
Achieved macro F1-score of 0.78 and 91% accuracy with class imbalance handling.

projects.name: Image Colorization using Deep Learning (GANs)
projects.summary: Computer vision application using generative adversarial networks.
highlights: Proposed deep learning-based image colorization method utilizing GANs.
Compared and studied efficacy in colorizing grayscale images across varied color space models.
